title: Approval waits drained the database pool
problem: Each /api/approvals/{id}/wait long-poll held a pooled database connection for up to 120 seconds while it slept, so a dozen waiting clients exhausted the pool and unrelated requests got 503 busy.
fix: The wait closes its session between reads so the connection goes back to the pool. The Python and JS SDK waits also retry 429 and 503 answers until their timeout.

title: Java SDK waits failed after 30 seconds
problem: approvals().waitFor and actions().waitFor ran each 120 s long-poll under the client's 30 s request timeout, so any wait longer than 30 s failed on a healthy server, and a busy 503 threw.
fix: Each round gets a timeout sized to its poll, the deadline follows the clock, and busy answers and dropped connections are retried.

title: code_asset calls hit 429 under normal app load
problem: code_asset was limited to 2 concurrent runs per tenant and 6 overall, so an app stepping a warm runner while running briefs and checks got 429 Too Many Requests.
fix: The default is 8 per tenant and 24 overall. Installs still on the old default are lifted on upgrade, admin-set values are kept.

title: A cancelled tool call kept its concurrency slot
problem: A direct tool call cancelled by a disconnect, timeout or pod restart never released its slot, so the tool answered 429 with one or two calls in flight until the counter expired.
fix: Slots are leases with an expiry, and a cancelled call releases its lease.

title: Pipeline execute without nodes answered a bare 422
problem: POST /api/pipelines/{id}/execute required nodes in the body, so a caller running a saved pipeline got Field required with no hint.
fix: Without nodes the agent's saved pipeline runs, and an agent with nothing saved gets a 400 that says so.

title: Code asset inputs over 128 KB failed on the Job path
problem: The archive and input went to the Job as environment variables or command arguments, so a 430 KB training set failed with exit 255.
fix: They reach the Job as files through a Secret volume mounted at /in, up to 950 KB.

title: A code asset lost its warm runner after one failed manifest read
problem: A failed read of the runner manifest was cached as having no manifest, so the asset lost its warm runner, warm-wait and prewarm until the pod restarted.
fix: A failed read is tried again on the next call.

title: A new code asset version started cold
problem: The first call to a new version of a warm asset ran as a cold Job, 151 s in one case, because its runner only started on that call.
fix: Uploading a version starts its runner, and a call waits briefly for a warm runner to come up.

title: Code asset schema validation cost 22 ms a call
problem: Every call re-checked the input and output schema against the metaschema, about 22 ms each time, twice per call.
fix: Validators are compiled once per schema. A twin step through the API went from 66 ms to 17 ms.

title: Large code asset test records broke jsonb
problem: The last-test record cut large JSON at 20,000 characters and stored the broken string as jsonb, which Postgres rejected on every large call.
fix: A record that is too big is stored as its size.

title: Kill switch could miss the next run
problem: A run started from a kill switch snapshot refreshed in the background, so a switch could miss the next run by up to ten seconds, and the message named the agent by id.
fix: Runs read a switch list no older than a second, a stale snapshot is reloaded before use, and the message names the agent.

title: Fresh installs had no database triggers
problem: The bootstrap built tables from the ORM and stamped alembic, so the four migration triggers were missing. The audit log could be edited and runs carried no provenance.
fix: bootstrap verify heals missing triggers and migration-only tables from the migrations' own SQL.

title: model_availability_events missing on fresh installs
problem: That table only existed in a migration, so the hourly model check failed with a 500 on every fresh install.
fix: The model is registered with the ORM and the bootstrap creates any missing table.

title: Agent-to-agent calls failed on a fresh install
problem: deploy.sh added the JWT keys after the pods started and never restarted them, so sub-agent calls failed with Could not sign a token.
fix: deploy.sh restarts every service that reads abenix-secrets after it generates keys.

title: Paged lists returned duplicate rows
problem: Rows inserted in one transaction share a timestamp and the order had no tie-breaker, so paging could return the same agent twice and skip another, 23 of 211 on a fresh install.
fix: Every offset-paged query orders by id as a tie-breaker.

title: Local Postgres crashed into recovery under load
problem: values-local.yaml capped Postgres at 512Mi, so a busy backend was killed and the database went into crash recovery, seen as random 500s.
fix: Postgres gets 512Mi requested and 2Gi limit.

title: Model availability stayed stale after connecting a provider
problem: Connecting a model, subscription or provider key left models unavailable until the hourly check, so requests were routed to a fallback.
fix: Availability is re-checked a few seconds after the change, and resolve reads it fresh.

title: Streamed runs ended with no answer at the step limit
problem: A streamed run that used its last step on a tool call ended with no answer.
fix: It gets one final turn without tools to answer from what it gathered.

title: Agent chat page kept no memory
problem: Chatting from an agent's own chat page saved nothing, so follow-ups started from scratch and never showed in history.
fix: The page saves the conversation and sends its id with each turn.

title: Builder snapped Sonnet back to the default model
problem: Picking Claude Sonnet 4.5 on a new agent snapped back to the platform default.
fix: The default is applied once when the builder opens.

title: Pipeline agent steps passed prose instead of JSON
problem: An agent step with an output schema passed on prose with a fenced JSON block, while the same agent run directly returned clean JSON.
fix: The step passes on the JSON its schema describes.

title: Scheduled trigger failures on a runtime pool were silent
problem: A scheduled trigger that failed on a runtime pool never told its owner.
fix: The run announcer sends the Scheduled trigger failed notice once per run.

title: ML model predict skipped the access check
problem: Predict checked only the tenant, so a user could call a model they could not see.
fix: Predict and explain answer 404 to a caller without access, like the detail page.

title: ml_model_register could read another workspace's file
problem: Path mode read any file in the shared export area by name.
fix: It reads only from the calling workspace's own folder and refuses without a tenant.

title: scripts/uat.sh dropped all but the last --spec
problem: Giving --spec more than once ran only the last spec.
fix: Repeated flags add up.
